about: Where each receiver really was (frames of the tracked clip, 30 fps, frame 0 = the calibrated frame in play_97.json), in yards from the ball in the offense's view. No jersey numbers: the far side's are unreadable at this resolution. Each man was followed by eye: either a tracker track whose box crops show his white jersey every half second, or a chain of raw detector boxes checked the same way. Marks stop where two receivers can't be told apart. Z marked to +2.5 s (then the chain ends on a coach in white). X (far) unmarked before +1.2 s. H (screen) unmarked.
